"HIGH SCHOOL LEGION

Full 3D American High School Football Simulation

1. GAME OVERVIEW

Create a fully 3D American high school football simulation game called HIGH SCHOOL LEGION.

The game should deliver an authentic American high school football experience. It should combine realistic football gameplay, school rivalries, player development, coaching, recruiting, season progression, team management, and immersive stadium presentation.

This is NOT an NFL game.

It must feel like actual American high school football, with suburban high schools, regular-sized football stadiums, school marching bands, student sections, coaches, referees, school uniforms, Friday night games, and local rivalries.

The game must be fully playable, with working controls, functional menus, realistic football AI, and complete game systems.

2. GRAPHICS AND VISUAL STYLE

Build the game entirely in 3D.

Graphics should include:

- Detailed 3D football players.
- Realistic player proportions and equipment.
- Individual player faces and hairstyles.
- Animated uniforms and equipment.
- Realistic football fields.
- Detailed grass and field markings.
- 3D stadium structures.
- Realistic lighting and shadows.
- Dynamic weather and atmospheric effects.
- Animated crowds and sidelines.
- Realistic player movement and animations.

Use a polished modern sports-game presentation.

The visual quality should be comparable to a modern console football game, but with a distinct high school atmosphere.

Avoid oversized professional football stadiums.

3. LEGION HIGH STADIUM

Create one permanent home stadium called LEGION HIGH STADIUM.

This is the main stadium used throughout the game.

It should resemble a typical American suburban high school football stadium.

Stadium features:

- Standard American football field.
- Realistic yard lines and hash marks.
- Painted end zones.
- Home and away sidelines.
- Metal bleachers.
- Press box.
- School scoreboard.
- Goalposts.
- Locker room entrances.
- Team benches.
- School banners.
- Stadium lights.
- Student section.
- Small marching band area.
- Parking lot outside the stadium.

The stadium must be reused for every game.

Different schools should have their own team colors, uniforms, logos, and end-zone graphics.

The physical stadium should remain recognizable.

4. GAME MODES

Include the following game modes.

QUICK GAME

- Select two high schools.
- Select home and away teams.
- Choose uniforms.
- Adjust weather.
- Set game difficulty.
- Choose game length.
- Start immediately.

SEASON MODE

- Play an entire high school football season.
- Manage a team through weekly matchups.
- Track wins and losses.
- Follow league standings.
- Manage player development.
- Compete for playoff qualification.
- Finish with a championship.

CAREER MODE

- Start as a high school football coach.
- Build a football program.
- Develop players.
- Create offensive and defensive strategies.
- Manage the roster.
- Improve team performance.
- Build a winning legacy.

WATCH MODE

- Watch games without controlling players.
- Let both teams operate through football AI.
- Switch camera angles.
- Watch full games.
- View replays and statistics.

TOURNAMENT MODE

- Create custom tournaments.
- Select participating schools.
- Generate brackets.
- Play elimination games.
- Compete for the championship.

PRACTICE MODE

- Practice passing.
- Practice running plays.
- Practice tackling.
- Practice blocking.
- Practice formations.
- Practice special teams.

5. TWO WAYS TO EXPERIENCE EVERY GAME

Before every game, allow the user to select:

1. PLAY THE GAME
2. WATCH THE GAME

PLAY:
The user controls the entire football team, including offense, defense, and special teams.

WATCH:
The game is controlled entirely by the AI, while the user watches the simulation.

Both modes must use the same football engine, player attributes, teams, playbooks, and game rules.

6. COMPLETE FOOTBALL GAMEPLAY

Implement authentic American football rules.

Include:

- Four quarters. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.

- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.

"HIGH SCHOOL LEGION

Full 3D American High School Football Simulation

1. GAME OVERVIEW

Create a fully 3D American high school football simulation game called HIGH SCHOOL LEGION.

The game should deliver an authentic American high school football experience. It should combine realistic football gameplay, school rivalries, player development, coaching, recruiting, season progression, team management, and immersive stadium presentation.

This is NOT an NFL game.

It must feel like actual American high school football, with suburban high schools, regular-sized football stadiums, school marching bands, student sections, coaches, referees, school uniforms, Friday night games, and local rivalries.

The game must be fully playable, with working controls, functional menus, realistic football AI, and complete game systems.

2. GRAPHICS AND VISUAL STYLE

Build the game entirely in 3D.

Graphics should include:

- Detailed 3D football players.
- Realistic player proportions and equipment.
- Individual player faces and hairstyles.
- Animated uniforms and equipment.
- Realistic football fields.
- Detailed grass and field markings.
- 3D stadium structures.
- Realistic lighting and shadows.
- Dynamic weather and atmospheric effects.
- Animated crowds and sidelines.
- Realistic player movement and animations.

Use a polished modern sports-game presentation.

The visual quality should be comparable to a modern console football game, but with a distinct high school atmosphere.

Avoid oversized professional football stadiums.

3. LEGION HIGH STADIUM

Create one permanent home stadium called LEGION HIGH STADIUM.

This is the main stadium used throughout the game.

It should resemble a typical American suburban high school football stadium.

Stadium features:

- Standard American football field.
- Realistic yard lines and hash marks.
- Painted end zones.
- Home and away sidelines.
- Metal bleachers.
- Press box.
- School scoreboard.
- Goalposts.
- Locker room entrances.
- Team benches.
- School banners.
- Stadium lights.
- Student section.
- Small marching band area.
- Parking lot outside the stadium.

The stadium must be reused for every game.

Different schools should have their own team colors, uniforms, logos, and end-zone graphics.

The physical stadium should remain recognizable.

4. GAME MODES

Include the following game modes.

QUICK GAME

- Select two high schools.
- Select home and away teams.
- Choose uniforms.
- Adjust weather.
- Set game difficulty.
- Choose game length.
- Start immediately.

SEASON MODE

- Play an entire high school football season.
- Manage a team through weekly matchups.
- Track wins and losses.
- Follow league standings.
- Manage player development.
- Compete for playoff qualification.
- Finish with a championship.

CAREER MODE

- Start as a high school football coach.
- Build a football program.
- Develop players.
- Create offensive and defensive strategies.
- Manage the roster.
- Improve team performance.
- Build a winning legacy.

WATCH MODE

- Watch games without controlling players.
- Let both teams operate through football AI.
- Switch camera angles.
- Watch full games.
- View replays and statistics.

TOURNAMENT MODE

- Create custom tournaments.
- Select participating schools.
- Generate brackets.
- Play elimination games.
- Compete for the championship.

PRACTICE MODE

- Practice passing.
- Practice running plays.
- Practice tackling.
- Practice blocking.
- Practice formations.
- Practice special teams.

5. TWO WAYS TO EXPERIENCE EVERY GAME

Before every game, allow the user to select:

1. PLAY THE GAME
2. WATCH THE GAME

PLAY:
The user controls the entire football team, including offense, defense, and special teams.

WATCH:
The game is controlled entirely by the AI, while the user watches the simulation.

Both modes must use the same football engine, player attributes, teams, playbooks, and game rules.

6. COMPLETE FOOTBALL GAMEPLAY

Implement authentic American football rules.

Include:

- Four quarters. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)
